newsitem.title: CHINA: China to change imports forex payment rules.
newsitem.headline: China to change imports forex payment rules.

text.p: China's State Administration of Foreign Exchange will take over the task of verifying foreign exchange payments for imports, formerly handled by banks, from March 1, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said banks lacked the management tools to efficiently handle the verifications.
Designated banks are required to report foreign exchange payments to the administration and importers must provide certificates on goods imported, it said.
The administration will periodically conduct random inspections of import companies, the paper said.
